tg.conclusion: Reviewed Telegram 0.77.0 (Core 0.370.0): tg guide lists memo's person-brief as 'One person across every tool' from cli-core MEMO_SCENARIOS; the scenario check now also refuses shell characters left unquoted in a step (tg's steps were already quoted). Core 0.363.0-0.370.0: store version 25 keeps a chat's history (chat_revisions) and a read by a re-keyed chat's old id finds it; a left chat is found by any of its ids in reads of its kept history, while chats track and store gaps plan refuse it. Changed native pages: changelog, and the v0.77.0 release links in cli-contract; RU/ES updated. Roadmap unchanged: richer sending, chat notes and max parity are not shipped.

max.conclusion: Reviewed MAX 0.66.0 (Core 0.370.0): max guide catch-up and the first screen of max --help quote the filter, max review 'date>1d' --unanswered 4h (unquoted, a shell wrote a file named 1d and dropped the filter; the site's correction for it is retired); Works with shows memo's title from cli-core MEMO_SCENARIOS. Core 0.363.0-0.370.0: store version 25 keeps a chat's history; a left chat is found by any id, chats track and store gaps plan refuse it. Changed native pages: changelog, scenarios (quoted step), and the v0.66.0 release links in bot/cli-contract/usage; EN/ES (RU scenarios) updated. Roadmap unchanged: optional local copy, event actions, video notes, cloud password and native installers are not shipped.

zm.conclusion: Reviewed Zoom 0.31.0 (Core 0.348.0 -> 0.370.0): Works with takes memo's person-brief title from cli-core MEMO_SCENARIOS; the scenario check refuses shell characters left unquoted in a step (zm's steps were already quoted); the shared store moves to version 25 (chat history) when first opened. Changed native pages: changelog; RU/ES updated. Roadmap unchanged: broader meeting preparation remains planned and is not shipped.
